svg.title: The two halves of the repository, and why they are judged differently
svg.desc: Code under tool slash runs on a developer's machine while they build, then exits. Nothing it depends on reaches the finished binary, so it can be as heavy as it likes and clarity is what matters. Code under pkg slash and instrumentation slash is compiled into somebody else's application and runs in their production system. Every dependency it adds becomes theirs, every millisecond is spent on their request path, and every panic it fails to contain is their outage. Restraint is what matters there.
svg.text: Ask one question before you open any file: does this stay in the workshop, or does it drive away?
Runs on a developer's laptop while they build.
Nothing it imports reaches the finished binary.
It can be as heavy as it likes.
One machine, one build, then gone.
Every dependency you add becomes theirs.
Every millisecond is on their request path.
Every panic you miss is their outage.
This is why the project has more than one go.mod, and why the same review comment can be right on one
side of the line and wrong on the other.
